fusions.name: Venom Cloud Descends
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 4 tiles of you takes 25 poison damage, ignoring armour, and becomes [Diseased] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Swallow What's Left
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 18 poison damage to the first enemy it meets and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Plague of Fangs
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm of biting snakes for 10 seconds that strikes enemies within 3 tiles for 3 damage every second.

fusions.name: Strip the Field
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
